versos.hebraico: וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הִתְיַחְשׂ֔וּ וְהִנָּ֣ם כְּתוּבִ֔ים עַל־סֵ֖פֶר מַלְכֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וִיהוּדָ֛ה הָגְל֥וּ לְבָבֶ֖ל בְּמַעֲלָֽם׃ס

controles.web: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel: and Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.
controles.kjv: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
controles.livre: E todo Israel foi contado por genealogias, e eis que foram escritos no livro dos Reis de Israel e de Judá, que foram transportados para a Babilônia por causa de sua transgressão.

versos.hebraico: וְהַיּוֹשְׁבִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּאֲחֻזָּתָ֖ם בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַלְוִיִּ֖ם וְהַנְּתִינִֽים׃

controles.web: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.
controles.kjv: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
controles.livre: E os primeiros habitantes que vieram a suas propriedades em suas cidades, foram os israelitas, os sacerdotes, os levitas, e os servos do templo.

versos.hebraico: וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ יָשְׁב֔וּ מִן־בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה וּמִן־בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וּמִן־בְּנֵ֥י אֶפְרַ֖יִם וּמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

controles.web: In Jerusalem lived of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
controles.kjv: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
controles.livre: Porém em Jerusalém habitaram alguns dos filhos de Judá, dos filhos de Benjamim, dos filhos de Efraim e de Manassés;

versos.hebraico: עוּתַ֨י בֶּן־עַמִּיה֤וּד בֶּן־עָמְרִי֙ בֶּן־אִמְרִ֣י בֶן־בנימן־בְּנֵי־פֶ֖רֶץ בֶּן־יְהוּדָֽה׃

controles.web: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.
controles.kjv: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
controles.livre: Utai, filho de Amiúde, filho de Onri, filho de Inri, filho de Bani, dos filhos de Perez filho de Judá.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־הַשִּׁ֣ילוֹנִ֔י עֲשָׂיָ֥ה הַבְּכ֖וֹר וּבָנָֽיו׃

controles.web: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
controles.kjv: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
controles.livre: E dos silonitas: Asaías o primogênito, e seus filhos.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־בְּנֵי־זֶ֖רַח יְעוּאֵ֑ל וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת וְתִשְׁעִֽים׃

controles.web: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
controles.kjv: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Zerá, Jeuel e seus irmãos, seiscentos e noventa.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־בְּנֵ֖י בִּנְיָמִ֑ן סַלּוּא֙ בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֔ם בֶּן־הוֹדַוְיָ֖ה בֶּן־הַסְּנֻאָֽה׃

controles.web: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah,
controles.kjv: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
controles.livre: E dos filhos de Benjamim: Salu, filho de Mesulão, filho de Hodavias, filho de Hassenua;

versos.hebraico: וְיִבְנְיָה֙ בֶּן־יְרֹחָ֔ם וְאֵלָ֥ה בֶן־עֻזִּ֖י בֶּן־מִכְרִ֑י וּמְשֻׁלָּם֙ בֶּן־שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה בֶּן־רְעוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־יִבְנִיָּֽה׃

controles.web: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
controles.kjv: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
controles.livre: E Ibneias, filho de Jeroão; e Elá filho de Uzi, filho de Micri; e Mesulão filho de Sefatias, filho de Reuel, filho de Ibneias.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲחֵיהֶם֙ לְתֹ֣לְדוֹתָ֔ם תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֑ה כָּל־אֵ֣לֶּה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.
controles.kjv: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
controles.livre: E seus irmãos, segundo suas genealogias, foram novecentos e cinquenta e seis; todos estes homens foram cabeças das famílias de seus pais.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים יְדַֽעְיָ֥ה וִיהוֹיָרִ֖יב וְיָכִֽין׃

controles.web: Of the priests: Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, Jachin,
controles.kjv: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
controles.livre: E dos sacerdotes: Jedaías, Jeoiaribe, Jaquim;

versos.hebraico: וַעֲזַרְיָ֨ה בֶן־חִלְקִיָּ֜ה בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֣ם בֶּן־צָד֗וֹק בֶּן־מְרָיוֹת֙ בֶּן־אֲחִיט֔וּב נְגִ֖יד בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ס

controles.web: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;
controles.kjv: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
controles.livre: E Azarias filho de Hilquias, filho de Mesulão, filho de Zadoque, filho de Meraiote, filho de Aitube, príncipe da casa de Deus;

versos.hebraico: וַעֲדָיָה֙ בֶּן־יְרֹחָ֔ם בֶּן־פַּשְׁח֖וּר בֶּן־מַלְכִּיָּ֑ה וּמַעְשַׂ֨י בֶּן־עֲדִיאֵ֧ל בֶּן־יַחְזֵ֛רָה בֶּן־מְשֻׁלָּ֥ם בֶּן־מְשִׁלֵּמִ֖ית בֶּן־אִמֵּֽר׃

controles.web: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
controles.kjv: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
controles.livre: E Adaías filho de Jeroão, filho de Pasur, filho de Malquias; e Masai filho de Adiel, filho de Jazera, filho de Mesulão, filho de Mesilemite, filho de Imer;

versos.hebraico: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֗ם רָאשִׁים֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבוֹתָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְשִׁשִּׁ֑ים גִּבּ֣וֹרֵי חֵ֔יל מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבוֹדַ֥ת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.
controles.kjv: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
controles.livre: Como também seus irmãos, cabeças das famílias de seus pais, mil setecentos e sessenta, homens valentes e hábeis para a obra do serviço da casa de Deus.

versos.hebraico: וּמִֽן־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַֽעְיָ֧ה בֶן־חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן־עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה מִן־בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי׃

controles.web: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
controles.kjv: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
controles.livre: E dos Levitas: Semaías, filho de Hassube, filho de Azricão, filho de Hasabias, dos filhos de Merari;

versos.hebraico: וּבַקְבַּקַּ֥ר חֶ֖רֶשׁ וְגָלָ֑ל וּמַתַּנְיָה֙ בֶּן־מִיכָ֔א בֶּן־זִכְרִ֖י בֶּן־אָסָֽף׃

controles.web: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,
controles.kjv: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
controles.livre: E Baquebacar, Heres, Galal, e Matanias filho de Mica, filho de Zicri, filho de Asafe;

versos.hebraico: וְעֹבַדְיָה֙ בֶּֽן־שְׁמַֽעְיָ֔ה בֶּן־גָּלָ֖ל בֶּן־יְדוּת֑וּן וּבֶרֶכְיָ֤ה בֶן־אָסָא֙ בֶּן־אֶלְקָנָ֔ה הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחַצְרֵ֥י נְטוֹפָתִֽי׃

controles.web: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
controles.kjv: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
controles.livre: E Obadias filho de Semaías, filho de Galal, filho de Jedutum; e Berequias filho de Asa, filho de Elcana, que habitou nas aldeias de Netofate.

versos.hebraico: וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים֙ שַׁלּ֣וּם וְעַקּ֔וּב וְטַלְמֹ֖ן וַאֲחִימָ֑ן וַאֲחִיהֶ֥ם שַׁלּ֖וּם הָרֹֽאשׁ׃

controles.web: The porters: Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),
controles.kjv: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;
controles.livre: E os porteiros foram: Salum, Acube, Talmom, Aimã, e seus irmãos cujo líder era Salum,

versos.hebraico: וְֽעַד־הֵ֔נָּה בְּשַׁ֥עַר הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מִזְרָ֑חָה הֵ֚מָּה הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לְמַחֲנ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי׃

controles.web: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward: they were the porters for the camp of the children of Levi.
controles.kjv: Who hitherto waited in the king’s gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
controles.livre: (O qual até agora fica junto à porta do rei ao oriente). Estes foram os porteiros do acampamento dos filhos de Levi.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁלּ֣וּם בֶּן־ק֠וֹרֵא בֶּן־אֶבְיָסָ֨ף בֶּן־קֹ֜רַח וְֽאֶחָ֧יו לְבֵית־אָבִ֣יו הַקָּרְחִ֗ים עַ֚ל מְלֶ֣אכֶת הָעֲבוֹדָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַסִּפִּ֖ים לָאֹ֑הֶל וַאֲבֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ עַל־מַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁמְרֵ֖י הַמָּבֽוֹא׃

controles.web: Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent: and their fathers had been over the camp of Yahweh, keepers of the entry.
controles.kjv: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the Lord, were keepers of the entry.
controles.livre: E Salum, filho de Coré, filho de Ebiasafe, filho de Corá, e seus irmãos da família de seu pai, os coraítas, foram encarregados da obra do serviço, guardando os umbrais do tabernáculo; assim como seus pais foram capitães do acampamento do SENHOR, que guardavam a entrada.

versos.hebraico: וּפִֽינְחָ֣ס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָ֗ר נָגִ֨יד הָיָ֧ה עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לְפָנִ֖ים יְהוָ֥ה׀ עִמּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and Yahweh was with him.
controles.kjv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the Lord was with him.
controles.livre: E Fineias, filho de Eleazar, havia sido antes comandante sobre eles, e o SENHOR era com ele.

versos.hebraico: זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּ֣ן מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֔ה שֹׁעֵ֥ר פֶּ֖תַח לְאֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
controles.livre: E Zacarias, filho de Meselemias, era porteiro da porta da tenda do ajuntamento.

versos.hebraico: כֻּלָּ֤ם הַבְּרוּרִים֙ לְשֹׁעֲרִ֣ים בַּסִּפִּ֔ים מָאתַ֖יִם וּשְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֑ר הֵ֤מָּה בְחַצְרֵיהֶם֙ הִתְיַחְשָׂ֔ם הֵ֣מָּה יִסַּ֥ד דָּוִ֛יד וּשְׁמוּאֵ֥ל הָרֹאֶ֖ה בֶּאֱמוּנָתָֽם׃

controles.web: All these who were chosen to be porters in the thresholds were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.
controles.kjv: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
controles.livre: Todos estes, escolhidos para porteiros dos umbrais, foram duzentos e doze; e estes foram registrados em suas genealogias, segundo suas aldeias; e Davi e o vidente Samuel os constituíram em seu ofício.

versos.hebraico: וְהֵ֨ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֜ם עַל־הַשְּׁעָרִ֧ים לְבֵית־יְהוָ֛ה לְבֵ֥ית־הָאֹ֖הֶל לְמִשְׁמָרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of Yahweh’s house, even the house of the tent, by wards.
controles.kjv: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
controles.livre: Assim eles e seus filhos estiveram junto às portas da casa do SENHOR, a casa do Tabernáculo, como guardas.

versos.hebraico: לְאַרְבַּ֣ע רוּח֔וֹת יִהְי֖וּ הַשֹּׁעֲרִ֑ים מִזְרָ֥ח יָ֖מָּה צָפ֥וֹנָה וָנֶֽגְבָּה׃

controles.web: On the four sides were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
controles.kjv: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
controles.livre: Os porteiros estavam aos quatro ventos: ao oriente, ao ocidente, ao norte, e ao sul.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֨ם בְּחַצְרֵיהֶ֜ם לָב֨וֹא לְשִׁבְעַ֧ת הַיָּמִ֛ים מֵעֵ֥ת אֶל־עֵ֖ת עִם־אֵֽלֶּה׃

controles.web: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them:
controles.kjv: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
controles.livre: E seus irmãos que estavam em suas aldeias vinham de tempos em tempos para durante sete dias servirem com eles.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י בֶאֱמוּנָ֞ה הֵ֗מָּה אַרְבַּ֨עַת֙ גִּבֹּרֵ֣י הַשֹּׁעֲרִ֔ים הֵ֖ם הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהָיוּ֙ עַל־הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת וְעַ֥ל הָאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: for the four chief porters, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.
controles.kjv: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
controles.livre: Pois havia naquele ofício chefes dos porteiros, que eram levitas; e eles eram encarregados das câmaras e dos tesouros da casa de Deus.

versos.hebraico: וּסְבִיב֥וֹת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יָלִ֑ינוּ כִּֽי־עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וְהֵ֥ם עַל־הַמַּפְתֵּ֖חַ וְלַבֹּ֥קֶר לַבֹּֽקֶר׃

controles.web: They lodged around God’s house, because that duty was on them; and to them pertained its opening morning by morning.
controles.kjv: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
controles.livre: E passavam a noite ao redor da casa de Deus, porque eram responsáveis pela guarda, e por abri-la a cada manhã.

versos.hebraico: וּמֵהֶ֖ם עַל־כְּלֵ֣י הָעֲבוֹדָ֑ה כִּֽי־בְמִסְפָּ֣ר יְבִיא֔וּם וּבְמִסְפָּ֖ר יוֹצִיאֽוּם׃

controles.web: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service; for by count were these brought in and by count were these taken out.
controles.kjv: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
controles.livre: Alguns destes eram encarregados dos utensílios do serviço, pois os colocavam contados, e contados os tiravam.

versos.hebraico: וּמֵהֶ֗ם מְמֻנִּים֙ עַל־הַכֵּלִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־כְּלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְעַל־הַסֹּ֨לֶת֙ וְהַיַּ֣יִן וְהַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְהַלְּבוֹנָ֖ה וְהַבְּשָׂמִֽים׃

controles.web: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, and over the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
controles.kjv: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
controles.livre: E outros deles eram encarregados da mobília, e de todos os utensílios do santuário, como também da farinha, do vinho, do azeite, do incenso, e das especiarias.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־בְּנֵי֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים רֹקְחֵ֥י הַמִּרְקַ֖חַת לַבְּשָׂמִֽים׃

controles.web: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the confection of the spices.
controles.kjv: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
controles.livre: E alguns dos filhos dos sacerdotes faziam o perfume das especiarias.

versos.hebraico: וּמַתִּתְיָה֙ מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם ה֥וּא הַבְּכ֖וֹר לְשַׁלֻּ֣ם הַקָּרְחִ֑י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֕ה עַ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הַחֲבִתִּֽים׃

controles.web: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.
controles.kjv: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
controles.livre: E Matitias, um dos Levitas, primogênito de Salum o coraíta, era encarregados das coisas que se faziam em assadeiras.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־בְּנֵ֧י הַקְּהָתִ֛י מִן־אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־לֶ֣חֶם הַֽמַּעֲרָ֑כֶת לְהָכִ֖ין שַׁבַּ֥ת שַׁבָּֽת׃ס

controles.web: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.
controles.kjv: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
controles.livre: E alguns de seus irmãos, dos filhos dos coatitas, eram encarregados dos pães da proposição, para os prepararem para todos os sábados.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הַ֠מְשֹׁרְרִים רָאשֵׁ֨י אָב֧וֹת לַלְוִיִּ֛ם בַּלְּשָׁכֹ֖ת פטירים כִּֽי־יוֹמָ֥ם וָלַ֛יְלָה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם בַּמְּלָאכָֽה׃

controles.web: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service; for they were employed in their work day and night.
controles.kjv: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
controles.livre: E destes também havia os cantores, cabeças das famílias dos levitas, os quais estavam isentos de outros serviços em suas câmaras, porque de dia e de noite estavam encarregados naquela obra.

versos.hebraico: אֵלֶּה֩ רָאשֵׁ֨י הָאָב֧וֹת לַלְוִיִּ֛ם לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

controles.web: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men: these lived at Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Estes foram os cabeças das famílias dos levitas, cabeças em suas genealogias, os quais habitaram em Jerusalém.

versos.hebraico: וּבְגִבְע֛וֹן יָשְׁב֥וּ אֲבִֽי־גִבְע֖וֹן יעואל וְשֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מַעֲכָֽה׃

controles.web: In Gibeon there lived the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife’s name was Maacah:
controles.kjv: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife’s name was Maachah:
controles.livre: E em Gibeão habitaram: Jeiel, pai de Gibeão (e o nome de sua mulher era Maaca);

versos.hebraico: וּבְנ֥וֹ הַבְּכ֖וֹר עַבְדּ֑וֹן וְצ֣וּר וְקִ֔ישׁ וּבַ֥עַל וְנֵ֖ר וְנָדָֽב׃

controles.web: and his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
controles.kjv: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
controles.livre: E seu filho primogênito Abdom, depois Zur, Quis, Baal, Ner, Nadabe,

versos.hebraico: וּגְד֣וֹר וְאַחְי֔וֹ וּזְכַרְיָ֖ה וּמִקְלֽוֹת׃

controles.web: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
controles.kjv: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
controles.livre: Gedor, Aiô, Zacarias, e Miclote.

versos.hebraico: וּמִקְל֖וֹת הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־שִׁמְאָ֑ם וְאַף־הֵ֗ם נֶ֧גֶד אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עִם־אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their brothers in Jerusalem, over against their brothers.
controles.kjv: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
controles.livre: E Miclote gerou a Simeia. E também estes habitaram em Jerusalém junto de seus irmãos.

versos.hebraico: וְנֵר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־קִ֔ישׁ וְקִ֖ישׁ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־שָׁא֑וּל וְשָׁא֗וּל הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת־יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ וְאֶת־מַלְכִּי־שׁ֔וּעַ וְאֶת־אֲבִינָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־אֶשְׁבָּֽעַל׃

controles.web: Ner became the father of Kish; and Kish became the father of Saul; and Saul became the father of Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
controles.kjv: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi–shua, and Abinadab, and Esh–baal.
controles.livre: E Ner gerou a Quis, Quis gerou a Saul, e Saul gerou a Jônatas, a Malquisua, a Abinadabe, e a Esbaal.

versos.hebraico: וּבֶן־יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן מְרִ֣יב בָּ֑עַל וּמְרִי־בַ֖עַל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־מִיכָֽה׃

controles.web: The son of Jonathan was Merib Baal; and Merib Baal became the father of Micah.
controles.kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Merib–baal: and Merib–baal begat Micah.
controles.livre: E filho de Jônatas foi Meribe-Baal; e Meribe-Baal gerou a Mica.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י מִיכָ֑ה פִּית֥וֹן וָמֶ֖לֶךְ וְתַחְרֵֽעַ׃

controles.web: The sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Mica foram: Pitom, Meleque, Tareia,

versos.hebraico: וְאָחָז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יַעְרָ֔ה וְיַעְרָ֗ה הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת־עָלֶ֥מֶת וְאֶת־עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־זִמְרִ֑י וְזִמְרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־מוֹצָֽא׃

controles.web: Ahaz became the father of Jarah; and Jarah became the father of Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri became the father of Moza;
controles.kjv: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
controles.livre: E Acaz, que gerou a Jará, Jará gerou a Alemete, a Azmavete, e a Zinri; e Zinri gerou a Moza;

versos.hebraico: וּמוֹצָ֖א הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־בִּנְעָ֑א וּרְפָיָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: and Moza became the father of Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
controles.kjv: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
controles.livre: E Moza gerou a Bineá, cujo filho foi Refaías, cujo filho foi Eleasá, cujo filho foi Azel.

versos.hebraico: וּלְאָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם׀ בֹּ֨כְרוּ֙ וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּשְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְעֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְחָנָ֑ן אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל׃פ

controles.web: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
controles.kjv: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
controles.livre: E Azel teve seis filhos, cujos nomes foram: Azricão, Bocru, Ismael, Searias, Obadias, e Hanã; estes foram os filhos de Azel.
